Progressive disclosure is present (KPIs → table → chart); chart is below fold — consider optional expand or sticky summary.
Filters (search, recommendation, deadline) live in client component; URL sync would improve shareability and back-button behavior.
visual_hierarchy: Strong: hero title, KPI row, tools strip, then table. Fancy-card and kpi-card accents support hierarchy.
Gap: no clear visual weight difference between 'Run analysis' and 'Export to Odoo'; primary vs secondary CTAs could be stronger.
Table density is default; alternating rows and score indicator help; numeric columns use text-align: end (RTL-aware).
information_scent: Row click navigates to tender detail; breadcrumb/back from detail could be more prominent.
Deadline status (closing soon / open / past) and recommendation (INVEST/REVIEW/SKIP) are visible; estimated value and score are key scents — ensure they are above fold on small viewports.
accessibility: Skip link, focus-visible ring, semantic table structure (thead/tbody), and RTL table direction are implemented.
Chart (Tremor BarChart) may lack full ARIA/screen-reader description; KPI cards have aria-label on section but individual cards could use aria-describedby for value+label.
Color contrast: status uses semantic colors plus text; verify WCAG AA for --text-secondary and badge text on backgrounds.
performance_hotspots: Dashboard page is server-rendered; TendersListClient is client with table + chart — large list may benefit from virtualization or pagination (PAGE_SIZE=10 already).
BarChart from @tremor/react and all Radix primitives load in client bundle; consider dynamic import for chart below fold.

UI_patterns_and_interactions.kpi_change: Framer Motion: wrap value in motion.span; animate when stats change: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 4 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}. Optional number count-up with useMotionValue + useTransform.
UI_patterns_and_interactions.row_hover: CSS already: .dashboard-tender-row transition background. Framer: motion.tr whileHover={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--surface-muted)' }} transition={{ duration: 0.15 }}.
UI_patterns_and_interactions.sidebar_collapse: If adding sidebar: motion.aside layout width={open ? 220 : 64}; AnimatePresence for overlay. Use transform: translateX for RTL (translateX(100%) when closed in RTL).
UI_patterns_and_interactions.chart_hover: ApexCharts: dataLabels off or minimal; tooltip enabled; custom tooltip with formatted value and label. Framer: wrap chart in motion.div whileHover={{ scale: 1.01 }} for subtle lift.
UI_patterns_and_interactions.loading_skeletons: Framer: motion.div animate={{ opacity: [0.5, 1, 0.5] }} transition={{ duration: 1.5, repeat: Infinity }} for shimmer; or CSS .animate-shimmer. Stagger children: transition={{ delay: index * 0.05 }}.
framer_motion_snippets: KPI reveal: `const controls = useAnimation(); useEffect(() => { controls.start({ opacity: 1, y: 0 }); }, [value]); return <motion.span initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 4 }} animate={controls} transition={{ duration: 0.25 }}>{value}</motion.span>`

Stagger list: `const container = { hidden: {}, show: { transition: { staggerChildren: 0.05 } } }; const item = { hidden: { opacity: 0, y: 8 }, show: { opacity: 1, y: 0 } }; <motion.div variants={container} initial="hidden" animate="show"><motion.div variants={item} />...</motion.div>`
Lottie empty state: `import Lottie from 'lottie-react'; <Lottie animationData={emptyJson} loop={false} className="w-48 h-48" />` (add lottie-react if approved).

line_chart.data_contract: { series: [{ name: string, data: number[] }], categories: string[] }
line_chart.apex_config_snippet: chart: { type: 'line', toolbar: { show: false } }, stroke: { curve: 'smooth', width: 2 }, xaxis: { categories }, yaxis: { labels: { formatter: (v) => v.toLocaleString(locale) } }, tooltip: { y: { formatter: (v) => v.toLocaleString(locale) } }
line_chart.performance: Decimate: keep last N points on small width; use chart.animations.enabled: true but duration 300ms.

bar_chart.data_contract: { series: [{ name: string, data: number[] }], categories: string[] }
bar_chart.apex_config_snippet: chart: { type: 'bar', toolbar: { show: false } }, plotOptions: { bar: { horizontal: false, columnWidth: '60%', borderRadius: 4 } }, xaxis: { categories }, dataLabels: { enabled: false }, tooltip: { shared: true }
bar_chart.performance: Limit categories (e.g. top 10); avoid huge datasets without sampling.

stacked_bar.data_contract: { series: [{ name: string, data: number[] }][], categories: string[] }
stacked_bar.apex_config_snippet: chart: { type: 'bar', stacked: true }, plotOptions: { bar: { horizontal: false } }, xaxis: { categories }, legend: { position: 'top' }
stacked_bar.performance: Same as bar; stack only when series count is small (2-5).

donut.apex_config_snippet: chart: { type: 'donut' }, labels, legend: { position: 'bottom' }, dataLabels: { formatter: (v, opts) => opts.w.config.series[opts.seriesIndex] }, colors: [semantic colors]
donut.performance: Donut is cheap; limit segments to ≤7.

RTL_localization_plan.file_structure: messages/ar.json, messages/en.json; i18n/config.ts (locales ar, en); next-intl with app router (middleware or routing in i18n/routing.ts).
RTL_localization_plan.direction_handling: Set dir and lang on html or body from locale (ar → rtl, en → ltr). Use components/locale-html-attributes.tsx or layout.
RTL_localization_plan.arabic_typography_rules: Already: [dir='rtl'] { --leading-normal: 1.7; letter-spacing: 0.01em; } Headings use --font-arabic in RTL. Avoid fixed widths for text; use min-width and overflow-hidden text-ellipsis where needed.
RTL_localization_plan.line_length_truncation: Max width for long titles ~40ch or 100%; truncate with overflow-hidden text-ellipsis whitespace-nowrap; ensure tooltips or title attribute for full text.
RTL_localization_plan.date_time_saudi: Use date-fns with ar locale for ar; format with PP or PPP; for Saudi prefer 'Asia/Riyadh' for any time (Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, { timeZone: 'Asia/Riyadh', dateStyle: 'medium' })).
qa_checklist_rtl: All layouts flip: header, table columns, cards, form labels.
Numeric columns stay end-aligned (left in RTL).
Icons with direction (chevron, arrow) flip where meaningful (flip-rtl or RTL-specific icon).
Modal/dialog position correct; drawer from correct side (right in RTL).
Chart category axis and legend order RTL.
No overflow or clipping of Arabic text; line-break acceptable for long words.

checklist_wcag_aa_dashboards: Keyboard: All actions (filter, sort, open row, export, run analysis) reachable and activatable by keyboard.
Focus: Visible focus ring (already :focus-visible); no focus trap except inside modal; skip link to main content.
Tables: <table>, <th scope='col'>, <td>; id/headers if complex; caption or aria-label for table purpose.
Charts: role='img' + aria-label describing chart; or link to data table; ensure color not sole differentiator (labels/patterns).
Color contrast: Text and UI components meet 4.5:1 (normal), 3:1 (large); badges and status text checked.
Forms: Every input has visible label; errors associated with aria-describedby and aria-invalid.
Motion: prefers-reduced-motion respected (already in animations.css); no auto-play > 5s or provide pause.
accessibility_plan.automated_tests: axe-core in Playwright: await expect(page).toHaveNoViolations() or inject axe and run; run on dashboard and tender detail.
accessibility_plan.manual_steps: Full keyboard nav (Tab, Enter, Space, Arrow); Screen reader (NVDA/JAWS or VoiceOver) through dashboard and detail; Zoom 200% layout; RTL and LTR both.

performance_plan.critical_rendering_path: Server-render dashboard page; stream or suspense for heavy client; preload critical font files; defer non-critical CSS if any.
performance_plan.lazy_loading: Dynamic import TendersListClient or at least chart: const BarChart = dynamic(() => import('@/components/charts/BarChart'), { ssr: false }); Lottie: dynamic import lottie-react and JSON.
performance_plan.bundle_splitting: Code-split by route (Next.js default); ensure chart library in separate chunk; consider next/dynamic for below-fold tools card or chart section.
performance_plan.lighthouse_targets: Performance ≥90, LCP <2.5s, TBT minimal, CLS <0.1; Accessibility ≥95.
performance_plan.ci_checks: Lighthouse CI on preview URL (mobile); bundle size budget (e.g. first-load JS <200KB); optional Playwright LCP measurement.
